extensionDescription.message: Interrupt distracting feeds on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube without blocking intentional areas.

onboardingSummary.message: Allow the supported sites once, then AwayDoomscrollin' can interrupt distracting short-form feeds automatically.

onboardingAccessDescription.message: Access is limited to Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube so the extension can recognize protected routes and display its local intervention.

onboardingAccessLimit.message: No access to other websites is requested.

onboardingStatisticsDescription.message: The extension counts interventions separately for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. This version stores those counters only in this browser and sends no telemetry.

onboardingPlatformsDescription.message: Protection is targeted: only the distracting routes described below are interrupted, while intentional areas remain available.

onboardingInstagramDescription.message: Stories, Reels, individual posts, and home-feed scrolling are interrupted in Strict Mode. DMs, profiles, comments, and settings remain available.

onboardingTikTokDescription.message: For You, Following, Explore, LIVE, and new TikTok feeds are interrupted. Strict Mode closes videos; Balanced Mode opens one intentional video in Focused Viewing.

onboardingYouTubeDescription.message: Strict Mode closes Home recommendations and every Shorts surface. Balanced Mode allows one intentionally selected Short in Focused Viewing.

onboardingSettingsNote.message: You can change each platform setting later from the extension menu.

onboardingFinishNote.message: Your platform selections are saved immediately.

onboardingMobileTitle.message: Take the pause beyond your browser

onboardingMobileDescription.message: AwayDoomscrollin' also has a separate Android app for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. It has its own installation, permissions, settings, and privacy disclosure.

popupSummary.message: Interrupt distracting feeds on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

protectionActiveAll.message: Protection is active across all platforms.

protectionOffDescription.message: Turn on platform protections from Applications.

protectionNeedsAccessDescription.message: Choose Applications and allow the supported sites.

applicationsPageDescription.message: Control protection for each platform. Changes are saved immediately.

aboutPageDescription.message: AwayDoomscrollin' Browser is a free and open-source Resolve Community project.

communityWebsiteDescription.message: Meet the independent initiative behind the project

privacyLinkDescription.message: Read the extension's complete local-data disclosure

siteAccessDescription.message: Allow access to the supported sites so protection can run automatically, without clicking the extension first.

siteAccessGranted.message: Site access allowed. Reload the open site.

siteAccessReady.message: Protection can run automatically on supported sites.

instagramSettingDescription.message: Controls Instagram Reels, posts, and feed interruption.

instagramStrictModeDescription.message: Stories and profile posts are covered along with Home, Explore, and Reels.

instagramBalancedModeDescription.message: Stories and profile posts remain available; Home, Explore, and Reels stay protected.

tiktokSettingDescription.message: Controls supported TikTok feeds and videos.

tiktokStrictModeDescription.message: Feeds, profile videos, and individual videos are covered; messaging remains available.

tiktokBalancedModeDescription.message: Feeds stay closed; one video selected from search or a profile opens in Focused Viewing.

youtubeSettingDescription.message: Controls recommendation loops and Shorts without judging videos by duration.

youtubeStrictModeDescription.message: Home recommendations and every Shorts surface are protected; search, subscriptions, channels, and long videos remain available.

youtubeBalancedModeDescription.message: Shorts shelves stay hidden, but one Short deliberately selected from search, a channel, subscriptions, or your library opens in Focused Viewing.

tiktokProtectedAreas.message: For You, Following, Explore, LIVE, and chained video navigation

tiktokAvailableAreas.message: Messages; search, profiles, and Focused Viewing in Balanced Mode

youtubeProtectedAreas.message: Shorts feeds, chained navigation, autoplay, and recommendation loops

youtubeAvailableAreas.message: Search, subscriptions, channels, library, long videos, and Balanced Focused Viewing

interventionAnalysisDescription.message: Distribution of interventions saved in this browser — not screen time.

localOnlyNotice.message: No telemetry. Settings and data stay in this browser.

homeShroudDescription.message: Home feed is off. Stories and Direct Messages remain available.

homeStrictShroudDescription.message: Home feed and Stories are off. Direct Messages remain available.

exploreShroudDescription.message: Explore is off. Search remains available.

postShroudDescription.message: This post is covered. Messages and profiles remain available.

reelsShroudDescription.message: Reels are exited on entry. Messages and profiles remain available.

feedInterventionDescription.message: A vertical scroll was detected in Instagram's home feed. AwayDoomscrollin' paused the infinite feed before it could continue.

reelsInterventionDescription.message: AwayDoomscrollin' interrupted this Reels route. You can leave Instagram or continue to an intentional area.

postInterventionDescription.message: AwayDoomscrollin' interrupted this individual post before Explore could become another endless viewing loop.

exploreInterventionDescription.message: AwayDoomscrollin' covered the Explore grid in place and paused its endless scrolling. Search, messages, and profiles remain available.

tiktokInterventionDescription.message: AwayDoomscrollin' interrupted this TikTok feed or video before the next automatic scroll.

tiktokShroudDescription.message: The endless feed is closed. Messages remain available; Balanced Mode allows one intentional video at a time.

youtubeHomeShroudDescription.message: Recommendation loops are closed. Search, subscriptions, channels, and your library remain available.

youtubeShortShroudDescription.message: This short-form surface is covered to prevent an automatic viewing loop.

youtubeInterventionDescription.message: AwayDoomscrollin' interrupted this Shorts route. Normal YouTube videos remain available.

donateLinkDescription.message: Support the open-source development on Polar

confirmDisableDescription.message: Short-feed protection for this platform will be disabled. You can re-enable it anytime from the extension menu.
